hooks.name: Accessible theatre guard
hooks.description: When the agent edits the scene, styles or panels, check that new animation respects reduced motion and that new controls stay keyboard reachable and labelled.

action.prompt: You just edited UI. Check that any new animation or transition is switched off under [data-motion='reduced'], that new interactive elements (including the export button, the import file input and the notification switch in settings) are native buttons, inputs or links with an accessible name, that status messages are in a role=status region, that focus stays visible, and that text on the dark theme keeps WCAG AA contrast. Then run `npm run typecheck`.
